name: print-social-black-starburst-quotes-post-pink-outlines
title: Black post with white starburst, pink-outlined vintage portraits and tea props
whatItIs: A black 4:5 post with a big white spiky starburst behind giant black caps 'ЦИТАТ', a pink script number, a tilted pink caption block, two black-and-white classic-film portraits with thick pink outlines, and pink-outlined stickers of a teacup and a kettle. Arrow and handle pill sit at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Glamorous and playful; vintage stars make quotes feel timeless while pink keeps it modern.
techniques: Set a white starburst behind the title to create a burst of light.
Give vintage black-and-white photos thick pink sticker outlines.
Add small themed props (teacup, kettle) as stickers.
Use one pink for script, label and outlines.

vocabulary.definition: A spiky shape used as a highlight behind text.
A classic black-and-white photo removed from its background.
A small object cutout that supports the theme.
A single-colour stroke around all cutouts.
